rv.q: Arbery’s project as a playwright is to yank away that “dishonest mask of pretended order,” using the means he has at hand—the empathetic tools of performance and the electrifying effects of wild unreality.
Yet “Evanston” has moments of grace and sympathy, mostly owing to the conviction of its performers.

cn.t: Will Arbery's bracing play earns praise for its vibrant performances and striking design, with critics applauding its exploration of human decency amid forces beyond our control.
